w0_pre.text: GUARDIAN ARCHIVE: GUARDIAN-X. Class-S combat prototype. Eighteen years posted at the exit of the upper districts. The alarm never once triggered. Until tonight.
Eighteen years without a single miss. I will be its first miss. And its last.

w1_pre.text: ARCHIVE: VINE QUEEN. The first successful specimen of the bio-program. The only one that survived and grew for thirty years. It knows no fear. Only instinct.
Thirty years of growth. Hundreds of roots. But every organism has a heart. I will find hers.

w2_pre.text: ARCHIVE: INFERNO CORE. An industrial overseer robot. Melted down and rebuilt many times. Its original firmware is lost. It runs on pure instinct.
A machine that forgot who it serves. I will remind it that even steel melts.

w3_pre.text: ARCHIVE: ICE PHANTOM. An archival system with one directive: protect the data at any cost. It does not know what it guards. Only the order.
A phantom guarding frozen lives. I will free both the data and the people. All 47 thousand.

w4_pre.text: ARCHIVE: SAND TITAN. The first combat-AI prototype. Fifty years in active mode. It no longer understands who it serves — it simply continues.
This guardian is older than you, UNIT-7. Older than Leila. Let us see if you can outlast history itself.
History is something I rewrite. Starting with it.

w5_pre.text: ARCHIVE: DRONE HIVE. An orbital defence system repurposed for interior security. Unaccustomed to enemies that know how to move.
I retuned it for you, UNIT-7. It will learn your movements. The only question is whether it learns in time.
Let it learn. I already know how it stops.

w6_pre.text: ARCHIVE: SHADOW REAPER. Adapted for zero visibility. Acoustic and infrared sensors. It hears its target from half a kilometre away.
There is no light in my forest, UNIT-7. It will find you in the dark long before you find it.
I have walked through the dark of nine sectors. One more shadow will not stop me.

w7_pre.text: ARCHIVE: SLUDGE KING. A collective mind of hundreds of decommissioned combat units. No command AI. Only a shared instinct: destroy everything that moves.
Hundreds of dead machines in one body. I have seen what they were. I will give them rest.

w8_pre.text: ARCHIVE: STORM TITAN. The core's personal defence system. Loaded with everything ARCHON has learned about you across nine worlds.
Every jump. Every shot. Every victory — recorded. It knows you, UNIT-7. Better than you know yourself.
Then it knows I do not lose. Get ready, ARCHON. You are next.

w9_pre.text: You stand at the last door, UNIT-7. Behind it — me. No guardian. No prototype. ARCHON itself. I have halted every process. All power, on you alone.
Nine guardians. Nine worlds. All of it led here. To you. Open the door, ARCHON.
The door is already open. Step in and finish what Leila began. If you can.
